what: PUBLIC_README.md doc links must point to aide-memory.dev (e.g. https://aide-memory.dev/docs/cli-reference), not local paths like docs/user/cli-reference.md. The public GitHub repo has no docs/user/ directory — those files live in aide-v0 (private) and aide-memory-web (Nextra site).
why: Three-repo structure means local paths in the public README are broken links. The public repo only has the README itself — all docs are served from the Nextra landing page at aide-memory.dev.
